title: NCAA Football Surges with Monday Betting Promotions
seoTitle: NCAA Football Surges with Monday Betting Promos
subtitle: What is driving interest in 2026 season games
excerpt: Monday of the 2026 season brings high-profile matchups like Texas vs. Ohio State, along with betting promotions that attract bettors.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 2026 NCAA season is surging thanks to major matchups, such as Texas vs. Ohio State, and betting promotions that encourage new users to sign up at sports betting sites. These events spark the interest of fans and bettors looking for opportunities to earn bonuses and place wagers on games that could impact the Playoff.

Matchups Drawing Attention

The game between Texas and Ohio State, with the Longhorns as 1.5-point home favorites, stands out as one of the biggest of the week. The over/under is set at 49.5, reflecting the expectation of a high-scoring game. Other marquee matchups include Oklahoma vs. Michigan, Alabama vs. Kentucky, and Utah vs. Arkansas, each offering attractive betting lines and potential returns.

Featured Betting Promotions

For those looking to boost their bankroll, top betting sites are offering promo codes. DraftKings is offering $200 in bonus bets for new users who wager $5. FanDuel is providing $350 in bonuses, while BetMGM offers up to $1,500 in bonus bets with the code CBSSPORTS. bet365 also has promotions, featuring $365 in bonuses when making a $10 deposit using the code CBSBET365. These offers allow both new and existing bettors to explore different betting lines.

Impact of Recent Results

Several teams had surprising results in Week 1, such as Michigan, which won 13-12 in a controversial finish against Western Michigan, and Texas A&M, which dropped two spots in the rankings after defeating Missouri State 50-0. These results alter expectations for Week 2, creating betting opportunities on games that could be tighter than expected.

How to Take Advantage of Promotions

To use the promotions, users must sign up at the betting site, make a minimum deposit, and use the corresponding promo code. For example, by using the code CBSBET365 on bet365, the user receives $365 in bonus bets when placing a $10 wager. The rules for each promotion vary, but they generally require the user to place a minimum bet to activate the bonus and meet wagering requirements before withdrawing winnings.

Conclusion

With high-profile games, attractive betting promotions, and unexpected Week 1 results, Monday of the 2026 NCAA season keeps fans and bettors highly engaged. Take advantage of the available promotions and follow the matchups to maximize your chances of profit.
